name: Teriyaki Mushroom  Bowl with Carrots & Quick Pickled Cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups jasmine rice
4 ½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
¾ small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt. Thinly slice the cucumbers, add to the bowl, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic and the ginger; place in a small bowl. Add soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil to make the teriyaki sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Remove the stems of the portobello mushrooms; scrape out the gills using a spoon. Cut mushrooms in half and then slice crosswise into thin strips.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the yellow onions and cook for about 2 minutes. Add the mushrooms and continue cooking until the mushrooms have started to soften, about 6 minutes.
Add beans and teriyaki sauce to the skillet and cook 3 minutes more.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Peel and coarsely grate the carrots.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork, and drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Fold the oil and seeds into the rice.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice between bowls and top with mushrooms, cucumbers, carrots, and green onions. Enjoy!
